description: This file defines an interface and a class for a durable, persistent set data structure in Orleans, with serialization, snapshotting, and command application logic.

classes.name: DurableSet<T>
classes.description: A durable, persistent set implementation with snapshot and command log support, used within Orleans for state management.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears the set and logs the clear command.

methods.name: Contains
methods.description: Checks if an item exists in the set.

methods.name: CopyTo
methods.description: Copies the set items to an array starting at a specified index.

methods.name: GetEnumerator
methods.description: Returns an enumerator for iterating over the set.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds an item to the set and logs the addition if successful.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes an item from the set and logs the removal if successful.

methods.name: ApplyAdd
methods.description: Internal method to add an item to the set without logging.

methods.name: ApplyRemove
methods.description: Internal method to remove an item from the set without logging.

methods.name: ApplyClear
methods.description: Internal method to clear the set without logging.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the durable set (not implemented).

methods.name: ExceptWith
methods.description: Removes all elements in the specified collection from the set.

methods.name: IsProperSubsetOf
methods.description: Checks if the set is a proper subset of another collection.

methods.name: IsProperSupersetOf
methods.description: Checks if the set is a proper superset of another collection.

methods.name: IsSubsetOf
methods.description: Checks if the set is a subset of another collection.

methods.name: IsSupersetOf
methods.description: Checks if the set is a superset of another collection.

methods.name: Overlaps
methods.description: Checks if the set overlaps with another collection.

methods.name: SetEquals
methods.description: Checks if the set is equal to another collection.

methods.name: IntersectsWith
methods.description: Modifies the set to contain only elements also in the specified collection.

methods.name: SymmetricExceptWith
methods.description: Modifies the set to contain only elements that are in either the set or the specified collection but not in both.

methods.name: UnionWith
methods.description: Adds all elements from the specified collection to the set.
